title: Recorded tokens and start-time API-equivalent cost
summary: A session's recorded tokens and cost include every child agent (subagent) it ran, on every harness: Claude child transcripts, Codex child-thread rollouts and Cursor child-turn payloads all add to the same per-model totals. Context compaction and summarization calls that write no usage row are not counted and are never estimated; every usage note names this known undercount.
